item.text: The lexer masks escaped punctuation before it masks code spans for emphasis detection. That lets a backslash inside a code span escape its closing backtick in the masked copy, so the later emphasis scan treats the code and following delimiters incorrectly. I’m changing the mask pass to leave escapes inside code spans untouched.
